# {{ site.author.name }}

> {{ site.description | strip_newlines }}

{{ site.author.name }} is a {{ site.author.job_title }} at the {{ site.author.affiliation }}, and Co-Founder and Director of MenaML, with a PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering from the University of British Columbia. The research treats AI assurance as a systems problem: trustworthy LLM evaluation, secure agentic systems (agent interaction graphs, least-privilege authorisation, runtime policy enforcement), AI supply-chain security, and lifecycle AI governance. Earlier work covers socialbots and Sybil detection, blockchain analytics and dark web measurement.

Every page below is also available as Markdown. Contact details are on each page.
